text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I really dropped the ball in so many ways.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, time to get right back to training.
It's barely even a scratch, it'll heal in no time.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And let's just forget everything, clean and clear!
choice_data_list: You need to stay on bed rest for a while.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I'm totally fine!
I was just being a little clumsy earlier, that's all—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~!
Just remembering it is making me squirm again!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"See! I'm really fine now!
If you fuss over me any more, I won't be able to take it!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
I told you I'm not good at that kind of stuff, too...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, are you doing that on purpose?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haaah... That was genuine? Seriously, that's just so you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, I give up.
I don't want to embarrass myself any further...

"I didn't quite get it, but...
I managed to get Nice Nature to rest peacefully."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"When you put it that way... how should I say this?
I suddenly start feeling terrible about it."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! No good!
I'm starting to lose faith in myself!

Perhaps the pressure got to her,
because Nice Nature's condition ended up deteriorating...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You're really serious about it, aren't you?
Saying you believe in someone like me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, then... yeah.
I've gotta do my best to at least not mess things up."

Just as Nice Nature said,
the injury healed quickly...
and her condition after returning was top-notch!
